findings.scope: Local entry simulation, not an actual new Vercel deployment.
Two processes; worker pauses only its set call after production CAS validation. Parent uses the production trade reducer and direct set path, not a full concurrent Socket.IO trade test.
Deterministic store interleaving. Server error handler emits its previously held room.gameState; no UI screenshot or full network race claimed.
Two real server processes on the same host, same shared filesystem; no stolen token, uses owner token returned by create_room.
Architecture simulation of separate filesystem roots; no Vercel infrastructure measurement.
